articles.title: Johan Torgeby lämnar över rodret på SEB
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Johan Torgeby lämnar över rodret på SEB
articles.body_text: Johan Torgeby avgår som vd och koncernchef för SEB. Styrelsen har utsett vice vd Jonas Ahlström som tillförordnad på posterna. Enligt ett pressmeddelande från storbanken har Torgeby på tisdagen informerat styrelsen om att personliga och familjerelaterade skäl gör att han väljer att avgå. Han har suttit på posterna i nästan tio år och började på SEB 2009. Jonas Ahlström har varit anställd i SEB sedan 2005 och medlem i den verkställande ledningen sedan 2020. Styrelsen inleder nu rekryteringen av en ny vd och koncernchef.

articles.title: Jätteaffären klar – Paramount köper Warner Bros
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Jätteaffären klar – Paramount köper Warner Bros
articles.body_text: David Ellison kommer att vara chef för jättebolaget Skydance. Arkivbild. Jätteaffären klar – Paramount köper Warner Bros Mångmiljardaffären är nu klar. Paramount Skydance köper Warner Bros Discovery . Efter långa och många turer blev den stora affären klar på tisdagen. Inklusive skulder är affären värd drygt 110 miljarder dollar, motsvarande 1 100 miljarder kronor, rapporterar amerikanska medier. Det nya företaget, som kommer att heta Skydance, slår ihop två av Hollywoods största filmstudior. Det blir också hemvist för tiotals tv-nätverk och två stora strömningstjänster, Paramount+ och HBO Max. Paramountchefen David Ellison kommer att leda jättebolaget. ”I dag är en historisk dag, inte bara för Skydance utan för hela vår bransch”, säger han i ett uttalande.

articles.title: Utdragen budgetkris väntar Frankrike
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Utdragen budgetkris väntar Frankrike
articles.body_text: Frankrikes finansminister Roland Lescure försöker tona ned behovet av stödåtgärder från ECB för att hantera den franska budget- och skuldkrisen. Arkivbild Frankrikes politiskt hårt pressade regering står inför en utdragen och hård strid om budgeten för 2027. På marknaden skenar de franska riskpremierna till de högsta nivåerna sedan eurokrisen. Det behövs inte hjälp av Europeiska centralbanken (ECB) för att hantera räntechocken som skakar landet, enligt finansminister Roland Lescure. Det är inte där vi befinner oss, säger han till journalister. Vi behöver inte prata om scenarion i dag. Målet är ju förstås att vi måste undvika att hamna i ett sådant läge till varje pris. Det är därför vi insisterar på finanspolitisk åtstramning, tillägger han. Uttalandet görs medan hans regering – under premiärminister Sébastien Lecornu – på tisdagen formellt lägger fram en åtstramningsbudget för 2027 i det franska parlamentet. De offentliga utgifterna ska enligt förslaget ned med 54 miljarder euro (drygt en halv biljon kronor) jämfört med årets budget. Regeringen hoppas att det ska räcka med frysta löner för offentliganställda, justeringar i pensionssystemet och höjda trösklar för avdrag på inkomstskatten – i kombination med en fransk tillväxt på 1 procent nästa år. Åtrstamningsbudgeten kommer bara sju månader innan det franska presidentvalet nästa år, där franska väljare ska utse en ersättare till Emmanuel Macron. Och oroade investerare minns hur två tidigare franska regeringar i närtid fällts i förtroendeomröstningar till följd av just omstridda åtstramningspaket. Till pressen kommer att euroskeptikern och ytterhögerledaren Marine Le Pen redan leder i opinionsmätningarna inför presidentvalet. Det kommer att bli fram och tillbaka mellan regeringen, Nationalförsamlingen och senaten – möjligen en bra bit in i första halvåret 2027. Det kan antas skapa mer politisk osäkerhet, säger Jérémie Peloso, europeisk chefsstrateg på BCA Research enligt nyhetskanalen Euronews. Frankrikes statsfinanser präglas av en statsskuld på 119 procent av BNP. Det kan jämföras med Sveriges 35 procent av BNP. Budgetunderskottet beräknas till 5,4 procent i år och gör att skuldberget ser ut att fortsätta växa – vilket bidrar till att marknaden frågar sig om Frankrike verkligen klarar att hantera statsfinanserna på egen hand.

articles.title: Marknadsräntorna faller – Wall Street stiger
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Marknadsräntorna faller – Wall Street stiger
articles.body_text: Handlarna på Wall Street fick se nedgångar på måndagen. Arkivbild. Marknadsräntorna faller – Wall Street stiger Aktiekurserna på Wall Street i New York stiger direkt efter öppning. Detta sedan marknadsräntorna i USA börjat falla. Räntorna på amerikanska statsobligationer, oavsett löptid, har under en längre tid stigit till nivåer som satt press på aktiemarknaden. Under tisdagen vände de i stället nedåt rejält – vilket anses vara en stor förklaring till den muntra börsöppningen i New York. Efter ett par minuters handel har Dow Jones industriindex stigit 0,4 procent, breda S&P 500-index 0,5 och tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex 0,6 procent. Nasdaq stängde på rekordnivå på måndagen.

articles.title: EU-bas i budgetsamtal med Kristersson
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: EU-bas i budgetsamtal med Kristersson
articles.body_text: Europeiska rådets ordförande António Costa och Sveriges statsminister Ulf Kristersson, fotograferade vid ett toppmöte i Bryssel i fjol. EU:s rådsordförande António Costa har varit i nästan alla EU-länder utom Sverige för att diskutera nästa långtidsbudget. ”Utmärkt utbyte per telefon med Ulf Kristersson”, skriver Costa på X efter tisdagens diskussion. ”Vi avverkade mycket i dag, inklusive om EU:s långtidsbudget och konkurrenskraften”, heter det bland annat. Samtalet sker inför nästa veckas tunga EU-toppmöte i Bryssel då ledarna framför allt ska diskutera ett nytt kompromissförslag om långtidsbudgeten som tagits fram av ministerrådets ordförandeland Irland. Inför det har Costa besökt merparten av EU-länderna. Sverige har dock fått vänta, med anledning av det oklara läget inför och efter riksdagsvalet. Sverige tillhör de länder som kräver en betydligt mindre budget än vad som föreslagits hittills.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.summary: Joakim Paasikivi lämnar tryggheten i tv-studion för att själv uppleva krigets verklighet i Ukraina. articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Defence lawyer in Cornell University case calls for special prosecutor Letitia James to be removed
articles.summary: New York Attorney General Letitia James is investigating the rape allegations, but the lawyer says comments she made on the case should disqualify her.
articles.body_text: A lawyer for one of the seven men accused of participating in a Cornell University gang rape has called for the special prosecutor on the case to recuse herself over past public comments. The lawyer had said a social media post from New York Attorney General Letitia James throws into question her investigation's "integrity and independence". In the 28 September post, James wrote that "what this young woman has been forced to endure is horrific and unacceptable" and told survivors that "we stand with you". The university's administration is under fire over its alleged mishandling of the October 2024 incident and, according to US media, now faces a no-confidence vote by Cornell faculty. The university's Faculty Senate, a governing body comprised of professors and other academic staff, will vote on a resolution of no confidence next week, according to reports. A majority no-confidence vote would be a largely symbolic gesture, signalling the broader faculty's discontent and applying pressure on university leadership to act. The BBC has reached out to Cornell University for comment. Allegations made in a lawsuit against seven men and the Ivy League university have rocked the campus in New York state, with hundreds of students and faculty members gathering there on Monday in protest, and sparked anger across the country. New York Governor Kathy Hochul last week appointed James as a special prosecutor to investigate the case and how law enforcement and the university initially responded to the allegations made by a woman identified in the lawsuit as Jane Doe. Jane Doe has accused the university of failing to protect her, after she was allegedly drugged and raped by the men for several hours at a fraternity party. Days before she was appointed special prosecutor, James wrote on X: "What this young woman has been forced to endure is horrific and unacceptable. "I'm holding her in my heart and in my prayers," she continued. "To her, and to all survivors: you're not alone. We stand with you."

articles.title: Ghana arrests seven women over cedi 'money bouquets'
articles.summary: The arrests are part of the country's efforts to curb the misuse and abuse of the national currency.
articles.body_text: Ghanaian authorities have arrested seven people for allegedly using banknotes to make so-called "money bouquets" and decorate cakes. The Bank of Ghana says the practice is illegal and amounts to misuse and improper handling of the cedi, the national currency. The arrests, carried out in collaboration with the police, followed a tip-off that led to a swoop on the suspects, all women, accused of selling the bouquets in different parts of the capital, Accra. The arrests are the biggest enforcement of the law against misusing the currency. In July, the bank issued a notice warning this could amount to an offence. It warned against "acts that tend to depreciate or impair the national currency, including any conduct that undermines its lawful value or use". Bouquets of banknotes or cakes decorated with currency are often ordered as gifts for weddings, birthdays, graduations and other celebrations. The police have launched investigations, and the authorities say the suspects will be prosecuted. They could face a fine or jail term, to be determined by the court. Dinah Bonzi, an official in the Bank of Ghana's currency department, said anyone aiding or promoting such activities could also be arrested and prosecuted. ''The Ghana cedi is legal tender… and must be treated with respect. The misuse or abuse of the currency is an offence and may attract sanctions under the law,'' she said. "Today's arrest should serve as a clear warning to the public. Let us all handle the Ghana cedi with dignity." The central bank has repeatedly warned against activities such as "spraying" - or throwing money at events such as weddings - writing on or altering notes and using them in decorations such as floral-like bouquets in weddings, birthdays and other occasions. The use of money decorations has become more common in Ghana in recent years, with the practice also gaining a foothold in other African countries.

articles.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
articles.summary: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.
articles.body_text: A civilian cargo ship has sunk and its crew is missing after being attacked by drones in the Black Sea, Bulgarian officials say. A second vessel - carrying grain - was also hit within Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone, Prime Minister Rumen Radev said. Its 18 crew were rescued. Radev did not say who was behind the attacks, which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea, particularly the eastern side, as part of its war against Ukraine. Moscow has not commented on the latest incident, a day after it was accused by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky of striking a civilian vessel carrying corn. EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the attacks were "unacceptable". Air and sea drones were involved in the attacks at about 03:00 (23:00 GMT), some 70 miles (112 km) off the coastal town of Byala in eastern Bulgaria, Radev said. The sunken ship was flying under the flag of Togo, he said. Named the Alfa Watan, it was a Turkish-owned general cargo ship and was reportedly heading for Sulina, Romania. It is not clear what the Alfa Watan was carrying or how many people were on board. A Bulgarian vessel was close by, but when they arrived all they saw was an overturned boat and rafts as well as life jackets. A search operation has been launched. Radev said Bulgarian sailors had rescued the crew members from the second ship - including two who were injured in a fire on board. Eleven were Turkish and seven Indian nationals. That ship, the Able, was flying the flag of Palau and transporting grain. Its last reported position was five nautical miles (9km) from the Alfa Watan. Radev condemned the strikes as "a flagrant violation of maritime law". He told reporters: "Such an attack within the Bulgarian exclusive economic zone is absolutely unacceptable."

articles.title: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
articles.summary: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.
articles.body_text: Belgian-born physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space, shedding light on the distant universe. Halzen led the development of IceCube at the South Pole, which uses a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice fitted with light sensors to detect particles called neutrinos. These carry information about violent, high-energy processes in the cosmos. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences said "his vision and scientific leadership have been fundamental for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory". He first presented his vision for detecting neutrinos at the South Pole in 1988. Halzen, who is now a US citizen at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, told a news conference that he was surprised his idea worked so well. "I have to emphasise how lucky I was. Because when we started this project, everybody realised this was maybe a good idea, but very few thought it would work, including myself." Neutrinos are elusive subatomic particles. The Sun produces vast numbers of them: every second, billions pass harmlessly through an area the size of your fingernail. But IceCube is searching for much higher-energy neutrinos, those produced by violent processes far beyond our Solar System — in distant galaxies. It is composed of thousands of sensors on long cables that are drilled and frozen into a 1km cubic block of ice. Neutrinos can be thought of as astronomical messengers that point to those fundamental events. At the observatory, most neutrinos pass straight through the ice, but occasionally one interacts with it, producing particles that give off a telltale flash of light. These rare signals carry clues to where the neutrinos came from and the extreme conditions that produced them — allowing scientists to investigate places that ordinary telescopes cannot easily see.

articles.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
articles.summary: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.
articles.body_text: Former German spy chief August Hanning has been arrested on suspicion of espionage, treason and obtaining classified information for a foreign power, the German Federal Prosecutor's Office says. Hanning headed the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from 1998 to 2005 and has since been working as a private consultant. Prosecutors allege that he used classified intelligence to "draft an analysis" for one foreign intelligence service and maintained contact with another foreign spying service. Investigators have not disclosed which foreign powers were involved. Police also arrested former BND employee Manfred D, accusing him of passing Hanning about 2,000 classified documents for money. Manfred D, who was Hanning's bureau chief and remained in the BND until this year, is charged with aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage. Local media reported Hanning was arrested at his home in Nordwalde near Münster while Manfred D was arrested in Bavaria. Hanning is due in court on Wednesday and Manfred D will appear on Tuesday. Prosecutors say Manfred D, who also served as the chief of staff for Hanning's successors between 2012 and 2026, used his role to gain access to highly confidential information which he then passed on to Hanning "in exchange for remuneration". "The current findings suggest that, over the years, Manfred D provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many of which contained classified information to be used exclusively by the Federal Intelligence Service for internal purposes," the statement says. "On one occasion, Hanning used classified intelligence ... to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service," prosecutors said, noting it was not clear if "the material reached the intended recipient". Hanning is also accused of being "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D, for several years". Local media say Hanning's alleged possession of intelligence documents came to light during a separate case relating to German steakhouse heiress Christina Block. Hamburg public prosecutor's office accused Block of orchestrating the kidnapping of her two youngest children in 2023 due to a custody dispute. Investigators allege Hanning was involved in an earlier attempted kidnapping of the children, which he denies.

articles.title: Gyanesh Kumar: Police detain opposition leaders in Delhi demanding election commission chief's resignation
articles.summary: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.
articles.body_text: Police in Delhi detained several opposition lawmakers as they tried to march demanding the chief election commissioner resign over a controversial voter roll revision. Main opposition leader Rahul Gandhi, his sister Priyanka and other MPs were forced into a police bus. Released shortly after, they resumed their march and began a sit-in near Election Commission headquarters. It is the latest escalation in a growing row over a nationwide revision of voter rolls. Opposition parties accuse Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of overseeing a process that could benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), an allegation both the BJP and Election Commission have rejected. "Some of the MPs tried to take some other roads to the Election Commission building. We have officers stationed at multiple points, from where the protesters were picked up in buses and taken to different police stations," Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Manjeet Sheoran told the BBC. The police did not disclose how many lawmakers had been detained. The opposition said 237 MPs from a range of parties participated in the march. Tuesday's protest came just four days after the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), a Gen Z-backed online satirical movement, organised demonstrations in Mumbai and Delhi, also demanding the CEC's resignation. The group has described those demonstrations as the beginning of a nationwide campaign and has called for another round of protests on 10 October. At the centre of the controversy is the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The exercise began in the eastern state of Bihar in June 2025 before being expanded to other parts of the country. The Election Commission says the revision is intended to remove duplicate and ineligible voters from electoral rolls. More than 130 million names have so far been removed from draft voter lists nationwide. Opposition parties and activists allege that many eligible voters have been wrongly excluded and accuse the poll body of conducting the process improperly. The campaign against Kumar gathered momentum after an investigation by the Indian Express newspaper reported that election commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had formally objected at least 14 times over a 10-month period to decisions and orders they said had been issued in the Election Commission's name without their knowledge. According to the report, the objections related to issues including additions and deletions from voter rolls, access to the voter database and the security of electoral data. Some concerns were linked directly to the electoral roll revision programme. The Election Commission, a three-member body comprising the chief election commissioner and two election commissioners, defended its decision-making process, saying differing views were part of institutional functioning and that decisions had ultimately been taken unanimously.

articles.title: Fear and disruption for Ukraine's rail passengers as Russia escalates drone attacks
articles.summary: Ukrainians travelling by train are increasingly caught in the crosshairs of Russia's attacks.
articles.body_text: Ukraine's railways have kept the country running since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022. But attacks are intensifying, with more than half of all strikes on locomotives since then occurring this year alone, according to the state-owned operator. Yuliia Ponomarenko, 27, a marketing specialist from Kharkiv, found her journey to Warsaw last month suddenly interrupted just short of the Ukraine-Poland frontier. "The border guards started running around and shouting "Run! Get out of the carriages! There's shelling!" A Russian drone had just hit a locomotive near the same border , and a special train carrying former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other European dignitaries, had passed through minutes before. Passengers on Yuliia's train were kept waiting for six hours while the fire up ahead was put out and the line cleared, she says: "We were really lucky that we were delayed a little and it wasn't our train." She is among an increasing number of Ukrainian passengers facing disruption and long delays, as air raid alerts trigger emergency evacuations far from the battlegrounds of the east. In September alone, 5,831 trains had to be evacuated due to Russian drone attacks, state owned railway operator Ukrzaliznytsia told AFP news agency on Monday. This meant on average each day, 205 trains were stopped. It appears to be part of a wider assault on Ukraine's infrastructure, with two bridges attacked in Kyiv in the past few days and passengers of a metro train caught up in one of the strikes. Seventeen-year-old Anastasiia Ryvbalchenko has also experienced a narrow escape. She and her fellow passengers were forced to leave their train at 4am, towards the end of a long of a journey from Odesa to Kirovohrad on 16 September. "On my way to Odesa, there had been a lot of evacuations and now on my way back it was happening again," she says. "I was already thinking that if there was another evacuation, I just couldn't take it any more." An hour and a half later, as passengers waited in the dark, a drone struck nearby.

articles.title: Kenya confirms first case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus
articles.summary: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.
articles.body_text: Kenya has confirmed its first ever case of Ebola - a Kenyan citizen who has been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo for the past seven years. Health Minister Aden Duale said the patient, who fell ill a month ago, and was treated in several hospitals in DR Congo, died days after arriving in the capital, Nairobi. Duale said the patient boarded a flight on Saturday and underwent normal public screening at the main airport in Nairobi before he was transferred by a relative to a hospital in the city. More than 4,000 people have died from Ebola in DR Congo this year, in what is the second most deadly known outbreak of the disease. Shortly after DR Congo declared an outbreak of Ebola in May, it was also reported in Uganda, where two people died. However, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared that county free of the disease in August. Since then, all known cases of the highly infectious disease have been in DR Congo. The virus spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids such as blood or vomit. The current outbreak in DR Congo has been caused by the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, which is relatively rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment. ​​There are however four vaccines in development, with human trials for one of them launched in July. Duale confirmed that the Kenyan national had tested positive for the Bundibugyo species. According to the minister, the patient first travelled by road from DR Congo to the Ugandan capital, Kampala, where he boarded a flight to Nairobi. Duale said that after being taken to the Nairobi Hospital, the patient was transferred to an isolation facility that was built during the Covid-19 pandemic.

articles.title: Yemen: Children brave snipers and mortars to go to school near front line
articles.summary: In rare access to Taiz, the BBC World Service speaks to children, teachers and families affected by the war.
articles.body_text: Every morning at 6am, 10-year-old Rafeef and her younger brother get ready for school, putting on their cream and brown uniforms. She always looks forward to seeing her friends and learning about everything from maths to Arabic and Islamic studies. She can't wait to start studying English next year. But for Rafeef, the journey to school involves far greater risks than crossing roads or missing the bus. Her school in Taiz, south-western Yemen, stands on a mountain at the edge of a valley known as no-man's land - a heavily contested front line in the civil war between forces supporting Yemen's internationally recognised government, which is backed by Saudi Arabia, and the Iran-backed Houthis. On one side of the school is government-held territory, on the other are Houthi sniper positions. Rafeef's home is further down the mountain. Every time she goes to school, she has to walk uphill with her back towards the snipers. "I'm afraid," she says. According to Unicef, roughly 3.2 million children in Yemen were out of school even before the war escalated last month. It says thousands of children have been killed or maimed since the war began in 2014, while thousands more have been recruited by armed groups on both sides. Yet despite the risks, Rafeef says she does not want to stop going because she loves seeing her friends and it is her only chance to be with them. She begins naming the children in her classroom. Going to school is the only time Rafeef's parents let her go outside. They say they are keen for her to get an education and have the chance of a better life. Rafeef hopes to become a doctor. Rafeef's family moved to Taiz from the coastal city of Hudaydah nine years ago, seeking safety when Houthis took control there.

articles.title: Nigerian Air Force plane crash: Bola Tinubu declares three days of mourning as 25 killed
articles.summary: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.
articles.body_text: Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu has declared three days of national mourning after a military aircraft crashed in southern Ondo State, killing 25 people. Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo on Monday said 32 people had died but on Tuesday the Air Force clarified that 25 people had been killed - five crew and 20 passengers. Authorities say the plane was on a routine mission from Benin City to Lagos when it came down in a swamp near a naval base on Monday morning. After reaching the site, the aircraft was found to be submerged under water, officials said. A resident told the BBC that clothes and shoes had been found at the site. Smoke could be seen rising from the area. It is the deadliest crash involving a Nigerian military aircraft since 1992. The Nigerian Air Force has released the names of those killed, showing that 19 of those on board were military personnel. Tinubu offered his deepest condolences to those killed and has ordered a full investigation. The president also ordered national flags to be flown at half-mast across the country as a mark of respect for those who died. "This is a painful moment for our Armed Forces and for the entire nation," Tinubu said. "Our Air Force personnel put their lives on the line every day to secure Nigeria. Their sacrifice will never be forgotten," he added. The aviation minister earlier said he had been informed "of the disappearance of a military aircraft with tail number NGR 931, enroute Lagos from Benin at 0913 hours earlier today". Keyamo said "efforts to raise the aircraft on radio proved abortive" before subsequent confirmation that it had crashed near a naval base in Igbokoda, Ondo state.

articles.title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
articles.summary: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.
articles.body_text: The Pentagon has announced it will execute a former US Army major by firing squad, the first such military execution in more than 60 years. Nidal Hasan fatally shot 13 unarmed US soldiers at Fort Hood in 2009, injuring another 32. Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell announced on social media on Monday that Secretary of War Pete Hegseth had made the recommendation and President Donald Trump approved it. It will be the first military execution by firing squad since the end of World War Two. Parnell said the secretary of the US Army would set the time and place of the execution. "Judgement day for Hasan has finally come," he wrote on X. Hasan, a US Army psychiatrist from Virginia, killed 13 soldiers at the base in Texas in 2009 and later admitted in court he was the gunman and apologised for "any mistakes". He said during his court-martial in 2013 that he believed he was protecting Muslims and the Taliban in Afghanistan. The killings on 5 November 2009 were the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base. The attack took place in a crowded medical building where deploying soldiers were awaiting check-ups and vaccines. Hasan is currently one of four inmates on the US military's death row. A military execution requires approval from the US president, according to military law.

articles.title: What are the US midterms? A simple guide
articles.summary: US voters will head to the polls on 3 November in a ballot that could have a major impact on Donald Trump’s presidency.
articles.body_text: There are four weeks to go until the US midterm elections, when voters take part in a ballot that could have a major impact on the rest of Donald Trump's presidency. On 3 November, Americans will choose members of Congress, which is made up of two parts - the House of Representatives and the Senate. Elections take place every two years, and when they happen in the middle of the president's four-year term of office, they are called the midterms. A key task of Congress is to create and pass federal laws - laws that apply nationwide. The outcome of the midterms will decide which political party - Trump's Republicans or opposition Democrats - controls Congress and how easy it is for the president to carry out his plans. The results are also seen as a measure of how happy people in the US are with the president's performance so far. All 435 members of the House - the lower chamber of Congress - will be elected. They serve fixed terms of two years. The House is commonly where proposed laws are introduced and debated. Meanwhile, 35 of 100 seats in the Senate, the upper chamber, will also be up for grabs. Senators serve six-year terms. Among other jobs, they approve or block proposed laws that have been received from the House. On the same day, voters across much of the US will also choose state-level politicians. Governor contests in California, Florida, Georgia and Michigan will be among the most closely watched. The US economy is on the minds of many voters struggling with the price of fuel, groceries, housing and healthcare. Inflation remains above the level targeted by the US Federal Reserve, partly down to the war that the US and Israel started with Iran in February. Democrats argue Trump's programme of trade tariffs has also pushed up prices for Americans.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia urged to spare Sri Lankan sentenced to death over Facebook post
articles.summary: Anojan Sivarasa faces execution after he was found guilty of blasphemy over a Facebook comment.
articles.body_text: "I plead for mercy for the wrongs committed by my son. Please forgive him and send him back to us." Speaking through tears, Rasamanickam Yogalakshmi made a desperate plea for the life of her eldest son, Anojan Sivarasa. The 24-year-old migrant worker is facing the death penalty in Saudi Arabia after an appellate court found him guilty of blasphemy against Islam and the Prophet Muhammad over a comment he made on Facebook. The case has sent shockwaves through Sri Lanka, sparking widespread concern and civil society petitions across the country. Multiple political parties and government bodies have co-ordinated diplomatic efforts seeking clemency. However, the family has had no updates on his condition since 28 September. The Sri Lankan government has instructed the family to refrain from making further statements while diplomatic efforts take place. Saudi authorities have not published an official execution timeline, and it remains unclear when the sentence will be carried out. Saudi Arabia has a history of carrying out executions without warning families or foreign embassies, only informing relatives after the sentence has been carried out. Anojan was prosecuted after a dispute on social media following an incident that took place during a Hindu pilgrimage in Sri Lanka. In late June, footage of a young Muslim man kicking a dog following Hindu pilgrims circulated widely on social media, triggering religious arguments online. During the exchange, a user posted derogatory remarks about a Hindu deity, leading Anojan to post a response in Tamil insulting the Prophet Muhammad. Although Anojan promptly deleted his comment and posted an apology video, it was screenshot and brought to the attention of his employer and Saudi officials, leading to his arrest in July. His personal devices were subsequently seized, and his social media accounts were deleted by Saudi officials. "People in Saudi Arabia knew nothing about this matter. It was individuals in Sri Lanka who sent emails to the company where my brother worked. I do not even wish to mention who those people are," Anojan's brother, Hamsidan Sivarasa, told BBC Sinhala. The company employing Anojan notified the authorities in Saudi Arabia who registered a case against him, according to Hamsidan. Anojan was initially sentenced to five years in prison as well as a fine of 3m Saudi riyals (about $0.8m; £0.6m) by the Al-Ahsa Criminal Court. An appeal submitted on Anojan's behalf seeking to reduce his sentence was rejected, according to Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Vijitha Herath.

articles.title: Yemeni military says it has retaken Mokha and 'secured' Red Sea waterway
articles.summary: Saudi-backed forces gave conflicting reports of whether they had also seized the port city of Mokha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
articles.body_text: Yemeni pro-government forces backed by Saudi Arabia say they have "secured" the Bab al-Mandab Strait at the southern end of the Red Sea, at the start of a major offensive against the Iran-backed Houthi movement. The Yemeni military also said in a statement that its forces had captured the Red Sea city of Mokha on Monday afternoon with the help of Saudi air strikes. But in conflicting reports, unnamed Yemeni government and military sources later told news agencies Reuters and AFP that the forces had only reached the city's outskirts. The Houthis denied losing Bab al-Mandab and Mokha and said they had struck Riyadh's airport and other locations in Saudi Arabia in retaliation for the air strikes. Saudi Arabia condemned the attacks and reiterated calls for the UN Security Council's permanent members to support Yemen's internationally-recognised government. Turkey and Pakistan, allies of Saudi Arabia, meanwhile held an emergency meeting in Riyadh and agreed to rapidly deploy military forces to Saudi Arabia in an invocation of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, according to a statement shared by Pakistan's foreign ministry. UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres condemned "the continued Houthi cross-border attacks" on Saudi Arabia and said he was "deeply concerned by the sharp escalation in fighting", in a statement to AFP. The offensive launched by the pro-government National Shield, Giants Brigades and Tihama Resistance forces in south-western Yemen on Monday reportedly saw the Houthis pushed out of most of the coastal areas they seized last month. Four government sources told Reuters that Yemeni forces had reached the outskirts of Mokha late on Monday, and that Houthi fighters were now retreating. Government military sources who spoke to AFP would not confirm the capture of the city, but said: "Our forces took control of the Dhubab military airfield and cut the road linking the Dhubab district to the Bab al-Mandab area." Earlier, the Yemeni military also said its forces had seized Dhubab airport, 45km (27 miles) to the south, and were besieging Houthi fighters inside the nearby town. Houthi‑run media cited a Houthi military source as rejecting as "Saudi propaganda" the claims that the group had lost control of Mokha, and that the group remained in control of Dhubab, Bab al‑Mandab and the Kahboub mountains near the coast.

articles.title: Perú vs. Colombia: horario, señal tv y dónde ver el amistoso
articles.summary: La selección peruana enfrentará a Colombia este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un amistoso internacional correspondiente a la fecha FIFA.
articles.body_text: La selección peruana ya tiene todo listo para su último compromiso de la fecha FIFA de octubre. Perú vs. Colombia se medirán este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un encuentro que marcará el cierre de la gira norteamericana dirigida por Mano Menezes. El partido comenzará a las 6:45 p. m. (hora peruana) y podrá ser visto en territorio nacional a través de América TV, mientras que la cobertura digital también estará disponible mediante América tvGO. El amistoso entre Perú y Colombia está programado para las 6:45 p. m. en Perú y Colombia, mientras que en Miami el inicio será a las 7:45 p. m. En otros países de Sudamérica, el encuentro comenzará a las 8:45 p. m. en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Paraguay y Uruguay. El escenario será el Nu Stadium de Miami, recinto con capacidad para más de 26.000 espectadores. Para los hinchas que quieran seguir el encuentro desde Perú, la transmisión estará a cargo de América TV. La señal también anunció que llevará los amistosos de la Bicolor durante esta fecha FIFA a través de sus plataformas. En consecuencia, el duelo ante Colombia podrá seguirse por televisión y mediante las opciones digitales habilitadas por América Multimedia. La Bicolor llegará al compromiso con la necesidad de cerrar la gira con una actuación positiva. Perú perdió 4-1 ante Estados Unidos, empató 1-1 frente a México y posteriormente cayó 2-0 contra Canadá. El encuentro ante Colombia será, por ello, el cuarto y último partido de esta serie de amistosos internacionales antes de los compromisos programados para noviembre. Colombia tampoco llega después de una victoria. El conjunto dirigido por Néstor Lorenzo empató 1-1 con México el 26 de septiembre y perdió 1-0 frente a Paraguay el 2 de octubre. La Federación Colombiana de Fútbol confirmó que el duelo contra Perú será el cierre de su participación en esta fecha FIFA, también como parte de su proceso de preparación para los próximos desafíos internacionales. Más allá del resultado, el amistoso tendrá especial importancia para el proceso de Mano Menezes. La selección peruana atraviesa una etapa de renovación y estos partidos permiten al comando técnico evaluar jugadores, probar variantes y encontrar una base para los siguientes desafíos. El duelo ante Colombia será además la última presentación de la Bicolor en esta fecha FIFA de septiembre-octubre. El partido también servirá como una nueva oportunidad para que Perú encuentre respuestas después de sus tres primeros encuentros de la gira. Colombia, por su parte, buscará cerrar su calendario con un triunfo después de sus resultados ante México y Paraguay. Con ambos equipos en procesos de preparación, el encuentro en Miami aparece como una prueba más dentro del camino hacia las próximas competiciones oficiales.

articles.body_text: Un incendio se reporta en el parque Domodossola, en Malecón de la Reserva, distrito de Miraflores. El siniestro ocurrió al promediar las 9 de la mañana. Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. articles.body_text: El candidato a primer regidor de la Municipalidad de Lima por Renovación Popular, Rafael López Aliaga, defendió su postulación y la posibilidad que pueda asumir como nuevo burgomaestre en el próximo periodo. El dirigente político sostuvo que su inscripción respetó las normas vigentes en la legislación electoral y que, tal como está la norma, podría incluso volver a postular en el 2030. “De acuerdo a la ley, en este minuto, hoy día yo podría ir hasta un tercer periodo. No es mi intención, pero podría”, declaró el postulante en una entrevista con RPP este viernes. El aspirante edil explicó que dicha opción legal derivó de su postulación como teniente alcalde y no como alcalde titular. López Aliaga precisó que la prohibición de reelección inmediata se refiere de forma exclusiva al cargo de alcalde. El candidato recordó que el Jurado Nacional de Elecciones respaldó la validez de su lista partidaria de manera definitiva en fallos recientes. “El verbo que se debe aplicar acá es postular, no estoy postulando a alcalde, estoy postulando a teniente alcalde, y por ausencia del titular me toca asumir”, afirmó el aspirante. El dirigente reiteró que su candidatura cumplió con los requisitos legales establecidos para el proceso edil. López Aliaga señaló que la normativa vigente prevé la entrega de la credencial de alcalde al primer regidor en caso de victoria de su partido. El postulante indicó que asumirá la conducción de Lima si Renovación Popular logra el triunfo en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. “Mi opinión personal, te digo que un alcalde sí debería tener una reelección, una reelección inmediata para poder terminar. Cuatro años es muy poco”, expresó el líder político. El candidato argumentó que las gestiones municipales requieren mayor tiempo para la ejecución de obras de infraestructura en la capital. “Este miércoles voy a declarar como acusador a toda la mafia criminal de ONPE y voy a meterlos a la cárcel 20 años por haber robado la voluntad popular”, sostuvo el dirigente. El candidato denunció supuestas irregularidades cometidas por las autoridades electorales durante los comicios anteriores del 2026 cuando buscó ser presidente de la República. López Aliaga, en otro momento, cuestionó la imparcialidad del Jurado Nacional de Elecciones en la resolución de las tachas presentadas contra postulantes. Por esto, confirmó la presencia de personeros en todas las mesas de votación para la vigilancia del escrutinio en la capital.

articles.title: Perú vs. Colombia: horario, señal tv y dónde ver el amistoso
articles.summary: La selección peruana enfrentará a Colombia este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un amistoso internacional correspondiente a la fecha FIFA.
articles.body_text: La selección peruana ya tiene todo listo para su último compromiso de la fecha FIFA de octubre. Perú vs. Colombia se medirán este martes 6 de octubre en Miami, en un encuentro que marcará el cierre de la gira norteamericana dirigida por Mano Menezes. El partido comenzará a las 6:45 p. m. (hora peruana) y podrá ser visto en territorio nacional a través de América TV, mientras que la cobertura digital también estará disponible mediante América tvGO. El amistoso entre Perú y Colombia está programado para las 6:45 p. m. en Perú y Colombia, mientras que en Miami el inicio será a las 7:45 p. m. En otros países de Sudamérica, el encuentro comenzará a las 8:45 p. m. en Argentina, Brasil, Chile, Paraguay y Uruguay. El escenario será el Nu Stadium de Miami, recinto con capacidad para más de 26.000 espectadores. Para los hinchas que quieran seguir el encuentro desde Perú, la transmisión estará a cargo de América TV. La señal también anunció que llevará los amistosos de la Bicolor durante esta fecha FIFA a través de sus plataformas. En consecuencia, el duelo ante Colombia podrá seguirse por televisión y mediante las opciones digitales habilitadas por América Multimedia. La Bicolor llegará al compromiso con la necesidad de cerrar la gira con una actuación positiva. Perú perdió 4-1 ante Estados Unidos, empató 1-1 frente a México y posteriormente cayó 2-0 contra Canadá. El encuentro ante Colombia será, por ello, el cuarto y último partido de esta serie de amistosos internacionales antes de los compromisos programados para noviembre. Colombia tampoco llega después de una victoria. El conjunto dirigido por Néstor Lorenzo empató 1-1 con México el 26 de septiembre y perdió 1-0 frente a Paraguay el 2 de octubre. La Federación Colombiana de Fútbol confirmó que el duelo contra Perú será el cierre de su participación en esta fecha FIFA, también como parte de su proceso de preparación para los próximos desafíos internacionales. Más allá del resultado, el amistoso tendrá especial importancia para el proceso de Mano Menezes. La selección peruana atraviesa una etapa de renovación y estos partidos permiten al comando técnico evaluar jugadores, probar variantes y encontrar una base para los siguientes desafíos. El duelo ante Colombia será además la última presentación de la Bicolor en esta fecha FIFA de septiembre-octubre. El partido también servirá como una nueva oportunidad para que Perú encuentre respuestas después de sus tres primeros encuentros de la gira. Colombia, por su parte, buscará cerrar su calendario con un triunfo después de sus resultados ante México y Paraguay. Con ambos equipos en procesos de preparación, el encuentro en Miami aparece como una prueba más dentro del camino hacia las próximas competiciones oficiales.

articles.summary: El Juzgado Penal de Investigación Preparatoria de Huaylas-Caraz dictó 18 meses de prisión preventiva contra dos investigados de nacionalidad venezolana por el asesinato de Susy Aponte Polo, conocida como China Polo. La resolución judicial incluye cargos por sicariato y lesiones graves contra cuatro ciudadanos que sufrieron disparos de arma de fuego durante el ataque.
articles.body_text: El Juzgado Penal de Investigación Preparatoria de Huaylas-Caraz dictó 18 meses de prisión preventiva contra dos investigados de nacionalidad venezolana por el asesinato de Susy Aponte Polo, conocida como China Polo. La resolución judicial incluye cargos por sicariato y lesiones graves contra cuatro ciudadanos que sufrieron disparos de arma de fuego durante el ataque. El Poder Judicial ordenó el internamiento penal de Luis Iván Obispo Díaz en calidad de autor directo del homicidio por encargo cometido en Huaylas. La Fiscalía le atribuye un pago de S/15,000 por ejecutar el disparo directo contra la postulante a la gobernación regional. La medida judicial comprendió además a Ronald José Toro Ardila como presunto financista y cómplice primario de la operación criminal. El Ministerio Público acreditó transferencias digitales desde su cuenta bancaria para pagar el hospedaje, los traslados y la compra del teléfono celular usado en el hecho. La Fiscalía sostuvo que ambos procesados carecen de arraigo domiciliario en el país y representan un peligro de fuga extremo. Las pericias balísticas, los testimonios presenciales y las inspecciones técnicas reforzaron los elementos de convicción aceptados por el juzgado. El juez dispuso el traslado de los imputados a un penal mientras continúan las diligencias de la investigación preparatoria. Las autoridades buscan determinar la identidad de los autores intelectuales que ordenaron el crimen de la candidata regional. El sicario atacó a disparos a China Polo el 19 de septiembre en las inmediaciones del mercado central de la ciudad de Caraz, en Áncash. La víctima realizaba una caminata proselitista junto a simpatizantes de su agrupación política cuando recibió el impacto directo en la cabeza. El atacante al usar su arma de fuego contra Aponte hirió a transeúntes y comensales en el lugar del suceso. Una mujer de 72 años perdió la vida doce días después debido a las graves heridas causadas por los proyectiles. Efectivos de la Policía Nacional capturaron a Obispo Díaz en la escena del crimen en posesión de una pistola tras un enfrentamiento armado. Las fuerzas del orden detuvieron posteriormente a Toro Ardila en Lima mediante un operativo de rastreo de sus cuentas bancarias.

articles.body_text: Un incendio se reporta en el parque Domodossola, en Malecón de la Reserva, distrito de Miraflores. El siniestro ocurrió al promediar las 9 de la mañana. Al lugar llegaron 16 unidades del Cuerpo de los Bomberos del Perú para atender la emergencia que causa preocupación entre los asistentes a dicha zona. Mario Casaretto, gerente de Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres de la Municipalidad Metropolitana de Lima (MML), indicó que parte de las geomallas utilizadas para evitar desprendimiento de rocas y plantas, han sido afectadas. Las llamas están cerca al centro comercial Larcomar y exactamente a 70 metros el recientemente inaugurado teleférico de Miraflores. Según testigos del siniestro, un grupo de turistas que paseaba por la zona fueron llevados nuevamente a su hotel para no ser afectados por el humo. También, algunas personas que en ese momento se encontraban en el Colegio Médico del Perú para votar por las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026, fueron cubiertas por cenizas. Personal de Serenazgo y la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), han cerrado esta vía en ambas direcciones. En tanto, los bomberos continúan realizando trabajos denodados para controlar el incendio y llegar hasta la zona donde se habría iniciado el fuego, sin embargo, el acceso al acantilado dificulta el acceso a las mangueras. Minutos más tarde de haberse producido el incendio, se reportó una persona herida. Canal N indicó que esta recibió atención en el lugar por parte de efectivos de la Policía Nacional del Perú (PNP), y personas que se encontraban en la zona. De acuerdo con información preliminar, se trataría aparentemente de una persona en situación de calle.

articles.title: Lucid Motors' EV output falls to lowest level in almost 2 years | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The company is deliberately limiting production after years of struggling to find mass-market demand for its EVs.
articles.body_text: Lucid Motors built 2,954 electric vehicles (EVs) in the third quarter of this year, a 54% drop from a year ago, as the company purposely limits production to better meet demand for its EVs. This was the third straight quarter in which the number of EVs Lucid built has declined. It’s also the lowest quarterly output since the first quarter of 2025, which was just after Lucid Motors started production of its second EV, the Gravity SUV . Lucid delivered 3,806 EVs in the third quarter, roughly flat with the second quarter and down about 200 vehicles from the third quarter of 2025. The company has struggled to find buyers for either of its first two luxury EVs. In five of the last six quarters, it built more vehicles than it delivered. Lucid’s new CEO, Silvio Napoli, has spent the last few months leading an effort to “simplify the company.” That effort has included laying off around 1,500 employees, streamlining the company’s leadership, and eliminating a second shift at its factory in Arizona in a bid to reach cost savings of $1.4 billion . Lucid also delayed the release of its third EV , the Cosmos. That model is supposed to be much cheaper, starting at under $50,000. The third-quarter figures, released Monday afternoon, come just a few days after rival EV upstart Rivian posted its best quarter in history on the back of the R2, its new, more affordable SUV . Although Rivian didn’t break out specific delivery figures for the R2, the company shipped nearly 20,000 vehicles in the third quarter , the first full quarter with the R2 in production, up from 12,194 in the second quarter . Lucid’s failure to find a large market of buyers for its EVs is even more stark when compared with the promises the company made when it went public in 2021. That year, Lucid Motors merged with a special purpose acquisition company and estimated it would ship as many as 90,000 EVs in 2024 alone . The company raised $4 billion in the transaction. On Lucid’s second-quarter earnings call in August, Napoli spoke about why he thinks the company has failed to make a dent in the EV market. “While there is no question that Lucid brought leading innovations and outstanding products to the market, we have disappointed on several fronts, and for far too long,” he said. “We have not executed consistently. We missed commitments, launched products before they were ready, underinvested in service, responded too slowly to quality issues, and allowed complexity to slow decisions down.” The Cosmos’ lower price could, in theory, let Lucid access a wider market, but Napoli cautioned shareholders that rushing the new EV out could create more trouble. “We will not repeat the mistakes of the past by bringing a product to market before it is ready,” Napoli said on the call. articles.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT's text in the EU | TechCrunch
articles.summary: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.
articles.body_text: OpenAI will start adding an invisible watermark to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex in the European Union to comply with the EU AI Act, the company said Monday in a blog post . The EU AI Act’s transparency rules , which took effect on August 2, require AI companies to mark AI-generated content in a way other systems can identify. OpenAI said the watermark will roll out over the coming weeks to eligible ChatGPT and Codex users on all plans, but only in the EU. Developers using OpenAI’s API anywhere in the world can turn it on for select models starting today; it’s off by default. OpenAI said it is not making text watermarking a global default at launch. The watermark is not an actual symbol, but works by subtly shaping the model’s word choices, leaving a pattern readers can’t see, but a detector can pick up. Because it lives in the words themselves, it travels with the text when it’s copied and pasted. OpenAI said the watermark doesn’t identify the user, and that it saw no meaningful change in its models’ performance with it switched on. OpenAI also published a technical report for its method, called textGrain, alongside the announcement. Co-written with researchers from the University of Pennsylvania and Yale, it walks through an example of using a secret key to sort next-word predictions to finish the sentence. Add hundreds of these nudges together, and the detector can spot AI-generated content using only the text and the key. Can the watermark be removed by editing? OpenAI’s tests suggest yes. In one test, replacing 10% of words with synonyms dropped detection from about 92% to 66%. The company also said short passages, math answers, and translated text are harder to detect. “These limitations contribute to our decision to provide initial detector access only to approved researchers and expert organizations, who can help us evaluate reliability and responsible uses,” said the company. OpenAI also cautioned that a missing watermark “does not prove human authorship.” The text could be too short or too heavily edited, or it could come from another company’s AI. “[Watermarks] can indicate that an OpenAI system generated or processed part of a passage, but not how much human judgment, editing, or creativity went into it,” the company said. The announcement comes two months after Anthropic said it would watermark text generated by Claude, a move it’s applying worldwide. That decision drew backlash from some Claude users , who argued they had supplied “the instructions, context, decisions” while Claude was just “the tool.” OpenAI had built a text watermark before but held off on releasing it, partly over concerns that users would switch to rivals that didn’t watermark, The Wall Street Journal reported in 2024. Anthropic, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI are among the companies that have committed to following the EU’s code of practice on AI-generated content.

articles.title: Etched fields funding offers at $40B+ valuation, sources say | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Just a couple of months after its last big raise, the AI chip startup is already being plied with investment offers at double or more its current value, sources tell TechCrunch.
articles.body_text: Although it’s only been a couple of months since Etched raised $700 million at a $21 billion valuation , the AI chip startup is already being plied with investment offers at double or more its value, according to people familiar with the company. Etched is reviewing incoming bids that range from $40 billion from top-tier investors to $50 billion from lesser-known backers, one person said. These fundraising talks are early, so terms of any deal, should one happen, may change. Etched declined to comment. While this may seem like a fast timetable to raise another mega round, Etched is pursuing a particularly expensive segment of the AI industry: building full AI hardware systems powered by its own proprietary chips. The person familiar with these offers said that if it raises as much as its last round, this could give Etched a cushion of as much as 3.5 years of runway. There are reasons why VCs are hot to own a piece of Etched. The four-year-old startup shows promise of challenging Nvidia. Not only did quant trading firm Jane Street lead the last $700 million round, it is also a customer that took delivery of an early system. Etched said in July that it had already secured $1 billion in customer orders, including the one from Jane Street, after manufacturing its test chip at a TSMC factory this summer. Co-founder and COO Robert Wachen previously told TechCrunch that investors are so enthusiastic because Etched has designed two new components from scratch to speed up inference — the computing process that happens after a user submits a prompt. The company claims its chips can process more tokens faster and at a lower cost than Nvidia’s. That’s the reason its processors have been so attractive to Jane Street, for whom a microscopic advantage in speed can yield massive profits. The startup has also impressed investors with its ability to attract engineers from Nvidia, with roughly 15% of Etched’s 400-person workforce having previously worked at the chip giant, according to The Wall Street Journal. Etched also operates a new 10-megawatt data center in Silicon Valley and established a facility in Taiwan to coordinate production near TSMC. Co-founders Gavin Uberti and Chris Zhu famously met in an advanced math course at Harvard, while Wachen was Uberti’s roommate and they dropped out to pursue the company. In terms of fast rounds at big leaps in valuations, Etched already has a history of them. The startup announced a $300 million round at a $10.3 billion valuation led by Sequoia in July. It announced the $700 million round at a $21 billion valuation in September. Back-to-back funding rounds, which essentially act as a single financing split into two tranches with separate valuations, are increasingly common among the buzziest startups.
